'''Mrs. Bjornson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[moisture farmer]] and the neighbor of [[Ariq Joanson]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
Her son was killed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] at five years ago.
